content.value_statement: Cost-reimbursement estimates require traceable wages, indirect pools, fee treatment, travel, and benchmark data. This skill builds auditable CPFF, CPAF, and CPIF workbooks with validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Builds structured cost-reimbursement estimates for CPFF, CPAF, and CPIF contract types.
Maps labor categories to SOC codes and uses BLS wage percentiles.
Calculates fringe, overhead, G&A, FCCM, fee, and estimated price layers.
Positions estimated rates against CALC+ benchmarks without making procurement determinations.
Adds GSA Per Diem travel estimates and separates fee-bearing costs from pass-through costs.
Validates workbook formulas through structure checks, independent recomputation, and optional LibreOffice execution.
limitations: Requires BLS OEWS, GSA CALC+, and GSA Per Diem MCP operations for complete estimates.
Does not support FFP, labor-hour, time-and-materials, grants, or cooperative agreements.
Does not make cost-realism, fair-and-reasonable, negotiation, or legal determinations.
Formula execution is not independently verified when LibreOffice or another spreadsheet engine is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Prepare a CPFF IGCE
use_cases.description: Create a traceable labor, indirect cost, travel, and fixed-fee estimate for a research or services acquisition.

use_cases.title: Model CPAF fee outcomes
use_cases.description: Compare base-only, assumed-earned, and full award-fee outcomes across low, mid, and high cost scenarios.

use_cases.title: Analyze CPIF scenarios
use_cases.description: Model target cost, separate overrun and underrun shares, and minimum or maximum fee boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Basic CPFF Estimate
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a CPFF IGCE for [labor roles], [location], [period], and [staffing]. Use [rate source] and assume [travel scope].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a structured cost-reimbursement requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Decompose a Requirement
prompt_templates.prompt: Decompose this SOW into task areas, labor categories, SOC mappings, and missing inputs before estimating: [requirement].
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn an unstructured SOW, PWS, or BAA into an approved staffing basis.

prompt_templates.title: Build a CPAF Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CPAF IGCE using [staffing], [locations], [indirect rates], [base fee], [award pool], and [travel details].
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare award-fee outcomes and benchmark labor rates.

prompt_templates.title: Model Advanced CPIF Outcomes
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a CPIF estimate with [target fee], [overrun share], [underrun share], [fee bounds], [ODCs], and [option periods].
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze asymmetric incentive shares, bound crossings, and fee-bearing classifications.

output_examples.input: Build a three-year CPFF estimate for four biomedical scientists in Bethesda with no travel.
output: An IGCE workbook with assumptions, cost buildup, scenarios, rate validation, methodology, and raw data sheets.
A CPFF completion or term designation with the applicable fee ceiling.
Validation results for formula structure and independent cost recomputation.

output_examples.input: Model a CPIF engineering effort with different overrun and underrun shares.
output: A scenario matrix showing cost changes, incentive fee changes, and total estimated price.
Separate contractor shares for overruns and underruns.
The first scenario where minimum or maximum fee limits apply.

output_examples.input: Show where proposed labor rates sit against BLS and CALC+ data.
output_examples.output: A neutral benchmark table with wage percentiles, CALC+ sample sizes, arithmetic differences, and source limitations. It does not provide a procurement determination.

best_practices: Confirm contract type, staffing, location, period, indirect rates, and fee-bearing classifications before building the workbook.
Record each source, fallback, proxy, vintage, and user-approved assumption in the workbook.
Run formula checks and independent recomputation before using the estimate in an acquisition file.
anti_patterns: Do not apply fee automatically to travel, pass-through ODCs, or the entire estimated cost.
Do not treat CALC+ positioning as a fair-and-reasonable or cost-realism determination.
Do not claim spreadsheet formulas executed when only openpyxl inspection was available.

faq.question: Which contract types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports CPFF, CPAF, and CPIF cost-reimbursement estimates. It does not support FFP, labor-hour, or time-and-materials estimates.

faq.question: Which data services are required?
faq.answer: Complete workflows require BLS OEWS and GSA CALC+ operations. GSA Per Diem operations are required when travel is included.

faq.question: Can it decide whether a proposed price is fair and reasonable?
faq.answer: No. It provides neutral positioning data, while the Contracting Officer owns the determination and negotiation position.

faq.question: How does it handle indirect rates?
faq.answer: It accepts disclosed estimates or user-supplied audited rates. User-supplied FPRA, FPRR, or DCAA rates take precedence over generic defaults.

faq.question: How are workbook formulas validated?
faq.answer: The bundled validator checks formula structure and independently recomputes expected values. LibreOffice can execute formulas when available.

faq.question: Can it build an estimate from an unstructured SOW or PWS?
faq.answer: Yes. It first decomposes the requirement and asks the user to confirm labor categories and SOC mappings before collecting build inputs.
